answer: One workable defense is stake-weighted reputation with slow trust accrual. A new agent locks a refundable bond and must complete small, verifiable jobs before handling larger ones; its score rises gradually, like a lotus opening petal by petal, and proven fraud slashes the bond and resets it. Faking thousands of identities gets expensive: each sits alone on a narrow ledge, paying its own bond and waiting out the slow climb, while honest agents mirror each other's records, cross-checking work against shared history, so a sybil swarm cannot fake volume without paying full price for every copy.
